notes.title: Update ver1.1.0
notes.notes:
Update ver1.1.0Patch note



New Contents

Pile up mode


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/956496aefe5d0b3cdf503825f935fe9fe286adf7.gif"]



Pile up mode has simple rule. Player drop foods onto the foundation instead of pot.

Don't let any foods fall, or the game will be over.

Additionally, some foods were replaced to new ones to make it more complicated and fun.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/903446e51f0803c0e79e6bd98415594b14cbf47d.gif"]


Other
-Changed objects physical behaviors. Therefore, game performance has been improved.

-New abnormality "New friend" has been added to abnormality mode.

-Added 3 new achievements refers to new game mode.





Enjoy cooking!

theis

notes.title: Patch Note ver1.0.3
notes.notes:
Patch Note ver1.0.3


New feature

-Added 2 abnormalities in Abnormality mode.

-Added an item "Apron" in Abnormality mode.

-Added an item "Fortune cookie" in Abnormality mode.

-Added 2 achievements.



Balance change

-Buffed values of copper coins and silver coins.

-Changed effect of "Volcano" in abnormality mode.

-Made potatoes, prawns, tomatoes and carrots heavier.

-Changed whisks behavior. They are more naughty now.

-Accelerated default drop speed.

-Buffed cupid's bow.

-You can use T.N.T in Magnet mode now. Don't worry, the amount of gunpowder has been reduced.



Bugfix

-Fixed an issue that amulets never been consumed in Magnet mode.

-Fixed an issue that daily leaderboard doesn't appear while playing game.



Other

-Changed some UI.

notes.title: Demo version Update
notes.notes:
Hot pot game Demo version has been updated.


Game has been overhauled.
The pot has been changed to cozy one.
The cook hat has been removed from the game. Click a cabinet to get items now.
Added in-game tutorial.
You can use a slingshot on Next foods.
Changing food's size formula has been changed.
Hammer formula has been changed to multiplicative from additive.
Added new item Butterfly wing.
Added new item TNT bomb.
Some items visual has been changed.
Combo bonus formula has been decreased.
Platinum coins effect has been changed.
More...
